# planner

Meeting scheduling helpers: merge busy intervals, list free slots, and find the first
slot that fits (a synthetic project written for half-life-bench).

Run the tests with `python -m pytest -q`.

## Usage

    from planner.schedule import first_fit
    first_fit([(600, 660)], 30)  # first free start, in minutes after midnight

from planner.clock import format_hhmm, parse_hhmm


def test_parse():
    assert parse_hhmm("09:30") == 570
    assert parse_hhmm("13:05") == 785


def test_format_round_trip():
    assert format_hhmm(785) == "13:05"
    assert parse_hhmm(format_hhmm(600)) == 600
